subject: Bar Chart Question --- Need a Sum Function?

messages.author: 21fdf3fb59f71376
messages.subject: Bar Chart Question --- Need a Sum Function?
parts:
Hi,

I entered the following code to make a bar chart. My data set has 365
rows with an entry for each day of the year. In the date column, I
have listed each date of the year (i.e. 01/10/08). In the Precip
column, I have recorded the precipitation of each corresponding day.
When I enter the following code, I get a bar chart for each day of the
year...
qplot(Date,Precip,data=weather,geom="bar")

however, I want a bar chart showing the cummulative sum of
precipitation for each month. So, I made a new column in my data
called Month where I simply assigned each day 1-12 according to the
month of the year. When I tried this code, I received this message:
> qplot(Month,Precip,data=weather,geom="bar")
stat_bin: binwidth defaulted to range/30. Use 'binwidth = x' to adjust
this.
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object "y" not found

I don't konw what to do to get the result I want. Any suggestions?

messages.author: e4aec126ff1dca22
messages.subject: Re: Bar Chart Question --- Need a Sum Function?
parts:
I think what you want to do is make a factor variable for the month,
then use plyr to create a new data frame with an additional column
which computes the cumulative sum (check the function cumsum) of the
precipitation by the month variable, so check out the plyr function
ddply. The code to make the plot would then be just like the first
plot you made, but with your new cumulative precipitation variable and
with the new data frame.

Cheers
david.
